top5.title: Split the 1240-LOC auth/service god module
top5.reasoning: Highest blast radius: login, tokens, and email share one module, so every auth change risks the others. Splitting is mechanical and well bounded.

evidence.note: single module owns login, tokens, and email

top5.title: Cover the untested payment refund path
top5.reasoning: Refunds move money and have zero coverage; a regression is high-impact and the fix is purely additive tests.
top5.suggested_fix: add unit + integration tests for refund flows

top5.title: Extract the retry loop duplicated across six clients
top5.reasoning: Six verbatim copies of backoff logic drift independently; one shared helper removes a recurring source of bugs.

top5.title: Delete the never-called legacy_export path
top5.reasoning: legacy_export is superseded and unreferenced; removing it shrinks the surface with no behavioural risk.

top5.title: Fix README install steps pointing at a removed script
top5.reasoning: New contributors follow install steps that reference a deleted setup.sh; a quick doc fix unblocks onboarding.

evidence.note: points at setup.sh deleted last release

top5.suggested_fix: update install section to current bootstrap
